title: Common
description: Shared definitions for the Ana outreach contract family (ADR-003). Not an artifact on its own.

identifier.description: Stable identifier. Cross-artifact relationships use identifiers, never embedded copies.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time with mandatory offset. Checked actively by the registry's FormatChecker.

draft_hash.description: sha256 over the canonical send_payload projection of an EmailDraft (ADR-003, algorithm send-payload-v1).

epistemic_status.description: Exactly the four classes of SPEC INTEL-001.

qualitative_rating.description: Qualitative fit rating. Numeric scores are intentionally not representable (INTEL-005).

contact_readiness.description: ELIGIBLE_FOR_GATES only permits advancement to later gates. It is NOT send authorization, compliance clearance or human approval.

execution_result.description: Result of a check or eval. PASS/FAIL require execution evidence (EVAL-006); enforced by the semantic validator.

execution_ref.description: Reference to the execution trace (run id, log locator). Required for PASS/FAIL.
